YOUR TIME IN TANZANIA

Day by day.

01DAY 1Arusha to Ngorongoro Crater - Africa's Grand Amphitheater

Depart from Arusha and journey toward the Ngorongoro Crater, one of the world’s most spectacular natural wonders, for a full day of wildlife viewing within one of Africa’s most iconic landscapes.

Descend 600 meters into the magnificent Ngorongoro Crater, a UNESCO World Heritage Site often called the “Garden of Eden.” This vast natural amphitheater boasts an exceptional concentration of wildlife—here you’ll encounter lions, elephants, buffalo, hyenas, and even the rare black rhino, while flocks of flamingos shimmer along the shores of Lake Magadi.

Your adventure includes a picnic lunch on the crater floor, surrounded by the rhythms of the wild. After an unforgettable day of game viewing, you’ll drive to your accommodation, where you’ll enjoy dinner and a restful overnight stay.

Stay Lake Manyara Wildlife Lodge

Meals & drinks Lunch & dinner (Breakfast not included) All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)

02DAY 2Lake Manyara National Park – Lakeside Wildlife & Birdlife

Travel to Lake Manyara, famous for its vibrant flamingos, tree-climbing lions, and a rich diversity of birdlife.

• Embark on morning and afternoon private game drives along the scenic lakeshore, spotting elephants, hippos, and other wildlife.

• Optional guided nature walks or photography excursions allow you to immerse yourself in the park’s serene landscapes and capture stunning images.

• In the evening, unwind at your lodge with panoramic lake views, enjoying exquisite dining featuring authentic local flavors and a tranquil ambiance.

Stay Tarangire Safari Lodge

Meals & drinks All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)

03DAY 3Tarangire National Park – Majestic Elephants & Baobabs

Enjoy a full day in Tarangire National Park, renowned for its vast elephant herds and iconic baobab trees. The park’s diverse landscapes span multiple vegetation zones, creating a striking setting for wildlife viewing.

The Tarangire River, the park’s main lifeline, attracts a wide variety of animals including elephants, lions, leopards, giraffes, zebras, buffaloes, antelopes, and abundant birdlife. With the highest concentration of elephants in Tanzania, Tarangire offers exceptional opportunities to observe their social behavior in the wild.

Pause for a picnic lunch at a scenic riverside viewpoint, where wildlife sightings may unfold nearby.

• Evening: Enjoy sundowners at the lodge as the sun sets behind ancient baobab tree.

Stay Tarangire Safari Lodge

Meals & drinks All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)

04DAY 4Tarangire to Arusha – Farewell to the Wild

Begin your morning at leisure, for a short game drive in Tarangire to catch one last glimpse of the park’s incredible wildlife.

After an unforgettable experience of wildlife and scenery, enjoy a scenic drive back to Arusha, taking in the stunning landscapes and reflecting on your safari adventures.

You will then continue your journey to Arusha or Kilimanjaro International Airport, where your safari comes to an end. Depending on your flight schedule, you may arrive earlier to ensure a smooth and relaxed departure.

• Conclude your unforgettable journey by continuing onward to your next destination, or extend your stay in Arusha to further explore the city and its surrounding areas.

Meals & drinks Breakfast & lunch (Dinner not included) Drinks not included
